title: Reliable Recipe Viewer Addons
description: Adds Reliable Recipe Viewer support to mods that need it.
body: # Reliable Recipe Viewer Addons Adds [Reliable Recipe Viewer](https://modrinth.com/mod/rrv) support to mods that need it. ## Supported Mods - **[Trailier Tales](https://modrinth.com/mod/trailier-tales)**: Allows sherd duplication recipes to be seen in RRV. - **[Linked Chests](https://modrinth.com/mod/new-linked-chests)**: Synchronize's the mod's recipe serializer, allowing its recipes to be seen in RRV. - **[The Block Box](https://modrinth.com/mod/block-box)**: Adds world interaction recipes for carving and stripping Palisades. ## FAQ - Will you add support for `X` mod? - Maybe! I'm prioritizing mods I use that do not have native integration. - I'm a developer, should I add support for RRV directly, or add it here? - I recommend mod developers add their RRV integration to their own mods. This cuts down on time spent managing dependencies on my end, and you know your mod better than I ever could. If one of your mods is supported via this addon, feel free to copy its code into official RRV integration! ## License [![Code license (MIT)](https://img.shields.io/badge/code%20license-MIT-green.svg?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/cassiancc/reliablerecipeviewer) Reliable Recipe Viewer Addons is available under the open source MIT License, matching the original mod.
